prose: Husband and wife super-duo Kyle Denton & Serena Marinelli join InnerVerse to talk about herbalism strategies for the stages of motherhood. Through their company, Tippecanoe Herbs, Kyle and Serena spread the sage wisdom of plant power and provide many products for life-enhancement. In the free hour, we discuss fertility, conception and pregnancy, and what herbal allies are equipped to nourish and relieve women through these exciting steps.
ext: We continue addressing various aspects of pregnancy, herbs for stimulating labor, the man's role in preparing and guiding the birth process, bringing consciousness to contractions, healing after baby comes, post-partum plants, enhancing breast milk production & nutrition, breaking generational trauma conditioning, and much more!
